verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a workflow-automation platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no documented version history, review, or rollback for workflows. Deploying sources from local code (pd deploy/pd dev) only lets users keep code in their own version control, which is a user-side workaround. The GitHub PR mention is about contributing registry components, not versioning user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
